faqs.q: Sec. 2-374. - Conduct constituting malfeasance and misconduct in office.
faqs.a:
An officer shall not commit malfeasance or misconduct in office and shall be subject
               to removal from office in accordance with the provisions provided herein in the event
               of any of the following:
(1)
Conviction of or an entry of judgment in any Colorado Court or an arbitration award
                  upon a charge of malfeasance or misconduct in office.
(2)
Conviction of or an entry of judgment by a Colorado Court including the Arvada Municipal
                  Court or an arbitration award of a violation of the Charter,
section 6.5
.
(Code 1981, § 2-54; Ord. No. 3088, § 2, 6-27-1994)
